health.title: Link health
health.problemsBody: Each count below in red needs a correction request. Nothing is fixed automatically.
health.unmeasured: Some checks could not be measured, so this is not an all-clear.
health.allClear: No duplicate links and no links across countries.

row.item_linked_twice: ERP items linked to two catalogue items
row.sku_linked_twice: Catalogue items linked twice in one country
row.cross_country: Links whose country differs from the item
row.oem_cross_country: OEM links in another country than the item
row.stock_no_item_code: of which carry an item code
row.stock_no_catalogue: Stock lines whose item has no catalogue link

detail.title: OEM {part}
detail.noManualRow: The approved link does not name the manual row it came from, so no model can be shown.
detail.noManual: The manual for this part was not found.
detail.noModelRecorded: The fleet register records no model for these assets.
detail.fleetTruncated: Not every fleet asset was read; the counts may be low.
detail.noStock: No stock recorded for these items.

approved.title: Approved OEM parts
approved.sub: Only links approved by a second person. Select a row for details; tick rows to request them.
approved.truncated: Not every link was read. Narrow the country to see the rest.
approved.noMatch: No approved part matches the search.
approved.empty: No OEM link has been approved yet. Links are proposed in the OEM cross-reference review and approved by a second person.
approved.requestSub: Creates one draft requisition per part. It still needs the normal approval.
approved.noPermission: You do not have permission to raise requisitions.

warn.differentDescription: Same code, different description. A code can mean a different item in another country.
warn.aliasNotVerified: The OEM number on the catalogue item is not verified.
warn.manyCandidates: This ERP item matches {n} catalogue items. Pick one; none is chosen for you.
warn.taken: This catalogue item is already linked to another ERP item in this country.

queue.doneProposed: Proposal stored. A second person must approve it.
queue.title: ERP items without a catalogue link
queue.sub: Proposed by exact code or OEM number only. A second person approves each link.
queue.note: An item code can mean a different item in each country. A match with the same code but a different description is marked and needs a person to check it. Items with no exact match are not listed here; they need a person to identify them in Material Master.
queue.summary: {total} proposed matches in {country}. This page: {exact} by code, {oem} by OEM number, {same} with the same description, {warnings} with a warning, {awaiting} awaiting approval.
queue.empty: No exact matches to review for this country.

unmatched.needsApprover: Needs an approver with the master-data right.
unmatched.codeMissing: Code {code} is not in Material Master for {country}. Add the item to Material Master first, or correct the code on the stock line.
unmatched.noSize: No tyre size could be read from this description, so no catalogue item can be suggested. A person must identify the item.
unmatched.whyLabel: Why is this the right item? (needed for a suggestion)
unmatched.whyPh: For example: brand and size checked on the shelf
unmatched.catalogueOnly: Catalogue only. Link it to an ERP item first.
unmatched.noPermission: You do not have permission to propose links.
unmatched.writeWhy: Write why this item is right first.
unmatched.exactFoot: The server checks the code again. A second person approves before the line is linked.
unmatched.suggestFoot: Suggestions only. They are ranked by tyre size and brand and are never applied automatically. A second person approves.
unmatched.exportFailed: The file could not be created. Try again.

kind.code_missing: Code not found in Material Master
kind.code_ambiguous: Code matches more than one item
kind.no_code_suggest: No code: suggestions by tyre size and brand
kind.no_code_none: No code and no usable size

unmatched.intro: Stock lines that are not linked to a Material Master item cannot show catalogue details, consumption or cost. Lines with a code are matched exactly. Lines without a code get suggestions by tyre size and brand that a person must confirm; nothing is linked automatically.
unmatched.twoPeopleBody: One person proposes the item for a stock line; a second person approves it. Nothing is linked automatically. Demo lines are test data and should not be linked.
unmatched.truncated: Not every line was read. Narrow the country or site to see the rest.
unmatched.title: Unmatched stock lines ({n})
unmatched.sub: Read {time}. Select a line to see every proposal.
unmatched.allLinked: Every real stock line is linked to Material Master.
unmatched.notSetUp: Linking is not set up yet in the database. The proposals can be reviewed and exported.

fitment.evidenceNote: Fitment is evidence, not a guarantee. A count means the fleet register records that make (and model). Most fleet assets have no model recorded, so a model count is a floor, not the real number.
fitment.fleetTruncated: The fleet register is larger than this screen reads, so the counts are incomplete.
fitment.lookupPh: Manual part number or company SKU
fitment.lookup: Which machines can this part be on?
fitment.manualNotReadable: The manual for this row is not readable in your scope.
fitment.lookupNone: No manual row has this part number, and no catalogue item with this SKU is matched to a manual row.
fitment.noManuals: No parts manuals are loaded for this scope.
fitment.noLinks: No OEM link has been proposed or approved yet. Accept a match in the OEM cross-reference review above to create one.
fitment.catalogueWithOem: Catalogue items that carry OEM numbers
fitment.stockSummary: {items} catalogue items carry an OEM number; {linked} are linked to an ERP item; {inStock} have stock on hand across {sites} sites.
fitment.stockTruncated: Some links or balances were not read in full, so a total may be low.
fitment.stockSearchPh: Company SKU, description or OEM number
fitment.notLinkedErp: Not linked to an ERP item
fitment.altSent: Sent for approval. A second person approves or rejects it in Corrections; until then {sku} is unchanged.
fitment.altNote: Record that part A can replace item B. The request is stored on B and waits for a second person in Corrections. You cannot approve your own request.
fitment.altTarget: B: the catalogue item that can be replaced
fitment.altValue: A: part number or company SKU of the replacement
fitment.relAlternative: A is an alternative to B
fitment.altReasonPh: Manual page, supplier notice or test result
fitment.altNone: No alternative or superseded reference is recorded yet. Pending requests are listed in Corrections.
fitment.unmatchedNote: Candidates use two exact rules only: the part number is equal to a recorded number, or every word of the manual description appears in the catalogue description. When more than {limit} items qualify the row is marked as too broad and no list is shown. A candidate is a lead to check, not a match. To link one, record the OEM number on the item through Corrections.
fitment.unmatchedSummary: {total} unmatched manual rows: {part} with an equal part number, {words} with word candidates, {broad} too broad, {none} with no candidate.
fitment.allProposed: Every manual row has a proposal.
fitment.moreQualify: {n} more qualify; the most specific are shown.
fitment.title: OEM fitment, stock and alternatives
fitment.sub: Which machines a manual covers, where OEM-numbered stock sits, and the manual rows still waiting for a match.
fitment.closedNote: Opens on demand: it reads the parts manuals, the fleet register and stock balances.
fitment.sourceTruncated: Some source tables were larger than this screen reads, so counts may be incomplete.

find.mixing: More than one item in a no-mixing location

loc.notSetUpTitle: Capacity and storage rules are not set up yet
loc.notSetUpBody: Capacity, storage rules, service vans and the utilisation report need migration 20261124133000 (not applied). The responsible person can already be named on each location.
loc.title: Capacity, rules and owners
loc.sub: Locations with a capacity, a storage rule, a named owner or a van. Breaches are reported, not blocked.
loc.empty: No location has a capacity, rule or owner yet.
loc.foot: Capacity compares the quantity on hand in the location's own unit; mixed units in one location are not converted.

tools.issueFailed: The tool could not be issued.
tools.noAccount: Someone without an account (type the name below)
tools.issueFoot: Without a due-back date the tool is never called overdue. A tool whose calibration is overdue cannot be issued.
tools.returnFailed: The return could not be recorded.
tools.calFailed: The calibration could not be saved.

lub.notSetUpTitle: Dispensing to an asset is not set up yet
lub.notSetUpBody: Lubricant grade, dispensing with asset and job card, and the consumption report need migration 20261124133000 (not applied). Stock below is read from the register as it is today.
lub.stockSub: Quantities are in the unit each line is stocked in. A missing unit is shown as Not recorded.
lub.stockEmpty: No lubricant is in stock for this scope.
lub.consSub: In-app dispenses and ERP oil issues. Values per currency; lines with no cost are counted as unvalued.
lub.consTruncated: Only part of the period was read. Choose a site or a shorter period.
lub.consEmpty: No lubricant was issued to an asset in this period.
lub.recentEmpty: Nothing dispensed in the app yet.
lub.shortage: Not enough free stock on this line.
lub.dispenseFailed: The dispense could not be saved.
lub.retryHeld: Press Dispense again to retry the same request; the form is held so it is never posted twice.
lub.gradeFailed: The grade could not be saved.

scrap.title: Scrap requests
scrap.notSetUpTitle: Scrap requests are not set up yet
scrap.notSetUpBody: The governed scrap flow (proposal, engineering evaluation, approval, write-off, disposal) is migration 20261124133000 and is not applied. Until then, scrap goes through a stock audit adjustment that a second person approves.
scrap.empty: No scrap request yet. Use Propose scrap on a stock line.
scrap.saveFailed: The scrap request could not be saved.
scrap.proposeFoot: Nothing leaves stock yet. An engineer evaluates it, a second person approves, then it is written off.

err.shortage: Not enough free stock on this line to write it off now.
err.value: Recovery value must be a number of zero or more.

opt.scrap: Scrap: cannot be used or repaired

scrap.postBody: This removes {qty} units from stock at their recorded cost. Units with no cost leave as unvalued.
scrap.valueFoot: Leave the value empty when it is not known. It is then reported as unknown, never as zero.

units.truncated: Only the newest units were read. Choose a site to see all of them.
units.empty: No serialised unit has an event recorded.
units.saveFailed: The event could not be saved.
units.noPermission: You do not have a permission for any event on this unit.
